plot_hand_mesh_from_angles: plot a 3D hand mesh from joint angles using plotly with configurable color and opacity
generate_hand_animation: generate an animated 3D hand mesh visualization from a sequence of joint angles with play controls
skin_vertices_from_angles: compute skinned mesh vertices from joint angles and a hand model profile using linear blend skinning
render_hand_frames_parallel: render hand mesh frames from joint angles in parallel using joblib for fast batch visualization
plot_ik_failure_regions: plot inverse kinematics failure regions overlaid on joint angle sum data using matplotlib
